notes.subject: feat(terminal): choose workspace directories inside the terminal panel
notes.summary: In multi-project workspaces, the AgentLink Terminal panel now shows its own in-panel directory chooser (keyboard navigable, cancellable) instead of VS Code's top-of-window quick pick.

notes.subject: fix(webview): prevent MCP row overlap in narrow panels
notes.summary: MCP Manager server rows no longer overlap in narrow panels; names and statuses stay above wrapping badges and actions, following the Manager's own width.

notes.subject: fix(codex): focus web fetch previews on explicit start lines
notes.summary: Codex web_fetch previews with an explicit start_line now begin at the first returned numbered line at or after it, so provider headers don't consume the preview budget.

notes.subject: fix(webview): keep MCP rows compact before wrapping
notes.summary: MCP Manager server rows stay compact and single-line when space allows, hiding secondary counts and badges before wrapping, with full status in tooltips and accessible labels.

notes.subject: fix(tools): preflight index-writing git apply workflows
notes.summary: Command preflight now recognises git apply --cached/--index workflows that write protected Git metadata and offers reviewed native execution, including a reusable command template when inline files were supplied.

notes.subject: feat(meridian): add AgentLink companion plugin and integration skill
notes.summary: Adds a standalone Meridian companion plugin and install script that keeps AgentLink's tools eagerly loaded for single-turn handoff, plus a maintenance skill and integration probe.

notes.subject: fix(webview): wrap copyable code blocks so the copy button stays anchored
notes.summary: Copyable code blocks in chat are now wrapped so the copy button stays anchored at the bottom-right while wide code scrolls.

notes.subject: feat(updates): add user-triggered self-update for CLI, Desktop, and VS Code
notes.summary: Adds user-triggered self-update: VS Code gets Install Update and Reload for Update commands, Desktop gets install/restart actions, and the CLI gets `agentlink updates --install` and an /updates install option, all with checksum-verified downloads.

notes.subject: feat(prompts): add per-model prompt profile selection across surfaces
notes.summary: Adds per-model prompt profile selection: compatible models accept promptProfile (compatibility or reasoning), applied across VS Code, Browser Ask Agent, Desktop and the CLI, with new Codex defaults and a new SDK prompt-profile entry point.

notes.subject: fix(feedback): preserve complete reports and retrieve them by id
notes.summary: send_feedback now preserves complete reports up to 128 KiB, and get_feedback gains id lookup with paging to retrieve the full record, while lists and the sidebar label shortened previews.

notes.subject: fix(webview): polish the release update dialog and default desktop buttons
notes.summary: Redesigns the release update dialog with a version headline, tinted install-state notices, a primary install action and quieter footer, hides Install when self-update is blocked, and themes default desktop buttons.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): allow locally signed builds to self-update to the release
notes.summary: Locally Team ID-signed Desktop builds can now self-update to the unsigned release after a confirmation explaining the Keychain and permission re-approval.

notes.subject: fix(desktop): move Check for updates into the More menu
notes.summary: Desktop's Check for updates action moved into the More menu; the title bar shows the update indicator only when a newer release is available.

notes.subject: fix(codex): treat provider cache-miss page errors as failed web fetches
notes.summary: Codex web_fetch now treats provider cache-miss and Internal Error page responses, including citation-prefixed Source headers, as failed reads so hosted fallback can recover.

notes.subject: fix(agent): align background result schemas and validation
notes.summary: Background agents' task result schema and runtime validation now share one contract, returning bounded field-specific diagnostics for rejected results.

notes.subject: fix(tools): surface skipped skill diagnostics
notes.summary: When load_skill rejects an exact SKILL.md path that discovery excluded, it now returns recorded validation diagnostics explaining why.

notes.subject: fix(tools): keep repo map file skeletons ahead of cache trees
notes.summary: get_repo_map now reserves budget for file skeletons and lists dependency/cache trees such as node_modules after project code.

notes.subject: feat(compose): allow read-only MCP tools as compose children
notes.summary: Compose scripts can now call read-only MCP tools through call_mcp_tool, and find_mcp_tools marks them read_only; approval policy is unchanged.

notes.subject: fix: recover expired MCP sessions, index tiny files, exact-save bulk replace
notes.summary: Adds save_without_formatting to find_and_replace, recovers expired Streamable HTTP MCP sessions, indexes tiny files, and lets embedded hosts set maxAttachments to 0.

notes.subject: chore(deps): update AI SDKs and in-range dependencies
notes.summary: Updates AI SDKs (openai, MCP SDK, ACP SDK, zod) and other in-range dependencies, and makes sandbox runtime packaging tolerate hoisted dependencies.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump pinned runtime dependencies
notes.summary: Bumps pinned runtime dependencies including sandbox-runtime, keyring, ajv, electron, ws and yaml.

notes.subject: feat(telemetry): record provider transport and fallback in session outcomes
notes.summary: Session outcome telemetry now records provider transport (WebSocket/HTTP) and fallback counts for completed API turns.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump Node library majors
notes.summary: Bumps Node library majors (eventsource, simple-git, https-proxy-agent, commander, marked, osx-sign) and fixes shadow-repo checkpoint creation that was silently failing.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump UI library majors and keep the CLI on Ink 7
notes.summary: Upgrades UI libraries (preact 11, monaco 0.57, xterm 6, mermaid 12), themes the xterm scrollbar, and keeps the CLI on Ink 7.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump web-tree-sitter and stabilise tests under Preact 11
notes.summary: Bumps web-tree-sitter to 0.27 and adds test setup to stabilise tests under Preact 11.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump vitest 5 and jsdom 30
notes.summary: Upgrades vitest and jsdom dev tooling and renames the vitest config to .mts.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump oxfmt to 0.72 and apply its formatting
notes.summary: Bumps the oxfmt formatter and applies formatting-only changes.

notes.subject: fix(terminal): match sandbox runtime proxy wrapper contract
notes.summary: Fixes the sandbox runtime helper's proxy wrapper checks to match sandbox-runtime 0.0.79, preventing repeated helper_protocol_failed errors.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): register Monaco services before creating diff editors
notes.summary: Fixes browser approval diff editors by registering all Monaco services before the first editor is created.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): recover streaming after replay eviction
notes.summary: Browser live updates now recover with a fresh session snapshot when reconnecting outlasts the gateway's retained event history.

notes.subject: chore(deps): update vega-lite and web-tree-sitter
notes.summary: Updates vega-lite to 6.5.0 and web-tree-sitter to 0.27.1.

notes.subject: fix(agent): continue safely after provider response truncation
notes.summary: Foreground chats now automatically continue up to twice after a provider truncates a response, never executing truncated tool calls, and show a paused warning if truncation persists.

notes.subject: fix(core): build CommonJS prompt profile export
notes.summary: Adds the promptProfilePolicy module to the core package's CommonJS build so its export is available to CommonJS consumers.
